input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Clause 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — outside the accepted set (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and an exclusive foreign venue, i.e. walk-away territory — and it conflicts with 28.2, which already vests exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, New York. The minimal cure swaps the governing-law words in 28.1 to the laws of the State of New York and deletes the conflicting Singapore forum wording (28.2 already supplies the forum), and confines the injunctive-relief carve-out in 28.2 to those same New York County courts, which the deterministic pairing check requires so that law and forum form one permitted corresponding pair. The 28.3 escalation process is unchanged and acceptable.
